holdings.name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Completed the acquisition of a 15.89% stake in Sudarshan Colorants India for ₹150.76 crore on 1 October 2026.
Maharashtra GST officials conducted an inspection search at company offices starting 1 October 2026, which concluded on 6 October 2026 with no material impact reported.
June 2026 net profit reached ₹103 crore on sales of ₹2,642 crore compared to ₹82 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 4.54% of the fund, it is the largest holding and contributed an estimated +0.44% to returns over the last 3 months with a 9.7% gain, reinforcing Materials exposure (26.2% of fund).

watch.text: Integration and financial impact of the 15.89% Sudarshan Colorants acquisition.

holdings.name: Usha Martin Ltd

what_changed.text: Executed a business transfer agreement on 25 September 2026 to sell the business undertaking of U M Cables to R R Kabel via slump sale for ₹77 crore.
Voluntary ESG rating improved to 63 from 60 for FY2025-26.
June 2026 net profit came in at ₹142 crore on sales of ₹1,033 crore, compared to ₹148 crore profit on ₹979 crore sales in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Represents 4.38% of the fund within the core Materials basket (26.2%); its modest 3-month return of -0.74% had a near-neutral impact on recent fund performance.

watch.text: Completion and cash receipt from the slump sale of U M Cables to R R Kabel.

holdings.name: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd

what_changed.text: The government acquired 7,200 sqm of company land in Nashik for ₹11.04 crore with no operational impact on the manufacturing plant.
June 2026 sales dropped sequentially to ₹303 crore with net profit falling to ₹33 crore from ₹144 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 4.30% in Industrials, its 3-month share price decline of -24.86% made it the fund's largest negative contributor (-1.069%), acting as the main drag on quarterly fund returns.

watch.text: Board meeting scheduled for 27 October 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year FY2027 results.

holdings.name: Tega Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Allotted 4,78,435 shares to AP Jupiter Holdings II on 15 October 2026, raising ₹95.40 crore at ₹1,994 per share.
Subsidiary Tega McNally bagged a ₹126 crore order from Kalpataru Projects.
Calcutta High Court set aside TMML reassessment proceedings for AY2017-18 involving a demand of ₹13.79 crore.
June 2026 quarter reported sales of ₹1,723 crore but recorded a net loss of ₹108 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.15% fund weight, its 18.55% 3-month rally yielded a +0.77% contribution, serving as a primary positive driver offsetting weakness elsewhere in Industrials.

watch.text: Execution of the ₹126 crore contract bagged by Tega McNally.

holdings.name: IDFC First Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Crisil reaffirmed ratings for ₹1,60,000 crore fixed deposits, ₹8,000 crore Tier II bonds, and ₹45,000 crore CDs on 17 October 2026.
Brickwork reaffirmed its BWR AA+/Stable rating on ₹406.90 crore NCDs on 8 October 2026.
Net profit surged sequentially to ₹1,148 crore in June 2026 from ₹331 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Comprising 3.68% of the fund and representing the bulk of its 5.4% Financials exposure; 3-month performance was down -2.83%, muting financial sector contributions.

watch.text: Earnings call scheduled for 24 October 2026 to discuss Q2 and half-year FY2027 results.

holdings.name: Wockhardt Ltd

what_changed.text: Announced plans to invest ₹500 crore into hospitals on 25 September 2026.
Received a customs order in August 2026 imposing a ₹5 crore penalty and ₹10 crore redemption fine over API misclassification.
June 2026 net profit stood at ₹107 crore with operating margin at 21%, following ₹164 crore profit in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 3.36% of the portfolio, it forms over 60% of the fund's 5.5% Healthcare allocation, recording a +2.85% 3-month return and a 40.11% gain over 6 months.

watch.text: Execution and funding milestones of the planned ₹500 crore hospital expansion.

holdings.name: Godrej Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Clarified to stock exchanges on 16 October 2026 that volume movements were strictly market-driven with full compliance maintained.
ICRA assigned AA+ stable to ₹1,500 crore NCDs and reaffirmed ratings on ₹8,700 crore NCDs and ₹3,500 crore CP.
CRISIL reaffirmed AA+/Stable rating on NCDs and A1+ on commercial paper.
June 2026 net profit dropped to ₹523 crore on revenue of ₹5,448 crore from ₹841 crore profit in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighs 3.11% as the entire Diversified segment (3.1%); its 3-month drop of -21.77% generated a -0.677% drag on total fund performance.

watch.text: Issuance and allocation under the newly rated ₹1,500 crore NCD program.

holdings.name: The Ramco Cements Ltd

what_changed.text: Completed debottlenecking at the Jayanthipuram facility on 29 September 2026, boosting clinker capacity to 5.62 MTPA and grinding to 4.38 MTPA.
June 2026 net profit dropped sharply to ₹31 crore from ₹151 crore in March 2026 and ₹386 crore in December 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Occupies 2.51% of the fund in Materials; an extended slide (-12.44% over 3 months, -20.34% over 6 months) contributed -0.312% to the quarterly performance deficit.

watch.text: Volume utilization from the newly expanded Jayanthipuram clinker and grinding capacities.

holdings.name: Cello World Ltd.

what_changed.text: Clarified to exchanges on 7 October 2026 that unusual trading volume was market-driven with no undisclosed material events.
Audit Committee and Independent Directors approved compensation for Wim Plast fractional entitlements under the amalgamation scheme.
June 2026 revenue was ₹527 crore with net profit of ₹73 crore, down from ₹90 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carries 2.49% weight within Consumer Discretionary (16.3% of fund); delivered +3.22% over 3 months and rebounded +16.45% over 1 month after a steep 1-year drop of -37.45%.

watch.text: Finalization and execution of the Wim Plast amalgamation scheme.

holdings.name: Quess Corp Ltd

what_changed.text: Issued reminder letters on 5 October 2026 for shareholders to claim fractional entitlement proceeds by 20 December 2026 before IEPF transfer.
SES upgraded the company's ESG rating to 64.8 from 63.3 in 2025.
June 2026 revenue rose to ₹4,182 crore with net profit improving to ₹82 crore compared to ₹64 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holds 2.34% of the portfolio in Industrials; strong quarterly momentum (+14.44% over 3 months, +68.70% over 6 months) helped cushion corrections in other industrial holdings.

watch.text: December 20, 2026 deadline for fractional entitlement claims ahead of statutory transfer.

portfolio.statement: Tata Small Cap Fund is heavily anchored in Materials (26.2%) and Industrials (21.9%), where strong performers like Tega Industries were counterbalanced by steep drawdowns in Kirloskar Pneumatic and Godrej Industries.
interp: Top contributors (Elantas Beck, Redington, and Tega Industries) generated over 2.6% in combined 3-month gains, but these were erased by heavy quarterly pullbacks in Kirloskar Pneumatic (-24.86%) and Godrej Industries (-21.77%).
Portfolio concentration remains moderate with the top 10 positions representing 34.9% of the ₹13,214 crore fund, and cash holding sitting at 8.2%.
portfolio.line: Performance was virtually flat over 3 months (+0.62%) as sharp declines in key industrial and diversified holdings canceled out robust manufacturing and technology gains.

drivers.text: Kirloskar Pneumatic dropped -24.86% over 3 months following a sequential net profit contraction from ₹144 crore to ₹33 crore, deducting 1.069% from fund returns.
Godrej Industries fell -21.77% over 3 months as June 2026 net profit declined sequentially to ₹523 crore from ₹841 crore, causing a -0.677% portfolio drag.
Tega Industries surged 18.55% over 3 months, lifted by a ₹126 crore project win at Tega McNally and fresh equity allotment of ₹95.40 crore, contributing +0.77% to the fund.

themes.title: Industrial & Manufacturing CapEx
themes.text: Heavy allocation to industrial equipment, engineering, and manufacturing supply chains facing varied execution cycles.

themes.title: Chemicals & Materials Integration
themes.text: Positioned across industrial consumables, pigments, and construction materials with mixed operational margin momentum.

macro.why: Quarterly volumes and project orders directly dictate profitability for specialized equipment suppliers and cement producers.
Debt refinancing terms, credit ratings, and interest costs influence margins and capital deployment programs across financial and holding entities.

priced_in.text: Sequential operating contraction in Kirloskar Pneumatic following its Q1 profit slide to ₹33 crore.
Depressed operating margins at The Ramco Cements, where June 2026 profit declined to ₹31 crore alongside ongoing capacity debottlenecking.

could_change.title: Turnaround in Industrial Earnings
could_change.text: A rebound in quarterly sales at Kirloskar Pneumatic or improved order intake across industrial holdings could reverse recent drag on the portfolio.

could_change.title: Materials Margin Recovery
could_change.text: Realization gains from Ramco Cements' expanded capacity and Sudarshan Chemical's acquisition could re-accelerate the fund's largest sector.

portfolio.risk_note: A 48.1% combined concentration across Materials and Industrials exposes the portfolio to cyclical industrial spending pauses and raw material cost spikes.
